about.text: Crafting timeless jewelry with passion and precision since 2010

Founded in 2010 by master jeweler Isabella Rossi, LUMIÈRE began as a small atelier dedicated to the art of fine jewelry making. Isabella's vision was simple yet profound: to create pieces that would transcend generations, becoming family heirlooms that tell stories of love, celebration, and legacy.
Today, guided by Isabella's daughter Elena, we continue this tradition of excellence from our New York atelier, blending century-old techniques with contemporary design.
"Jewelry is not just adornment; it is a story waiting to be told, a memory waiting to be cherished." - Isabella Rossi
We believe that fine jewelry should be accessible, sustainable, and meaningful. Every piece we create carries the same dedication to quality and artistry.
We source only the finest ethically-mined gemstones and precious metals, with each piece undergoing 47 quality checks before it leaves our atelier.
Every piece is handcrafted by master jewelers using techniques passed down through generations, ensuring unparalleled attention to detail.
We believe jewelry should tell your unique story. Our designers work closely with clients to create pieces that reflect personal style and significance.

Each LUMIÈRE piece begins with a vision, translated into precise hand-drawn sketches by our design team. From these drawings, our master jewelers select the finest materials and begin the meticulous process of creation.

Our signature setting technique allows diamonds and gemstones to capture maximum light while ensuring exceptional security. This proprietary method takes three times longer than standard settings but results in unparalleled brilliance.
The talented individuals behind every exquisite piece
With over 30 years of experience, Isabella brings her passion for artistry and innovation to every collection.
Carrying forward her mother's legacy, Elena combines traditional techniques with modern aesthetics.
With 25 years of experience, Marcus specializes in intricate metalwork and stone setting.
GIA-certified gemologist ensuring every stone meets our rigorous quality and ethical standards.
Isabella Rossi opens LUMIÈRE in a small atelier in Florence, Italy, specializing in bespoke engagement rings.
LUMIÈRE opens its first flagship boutique on Fifth Avenue, bringing Italian craftsmanship to New York.
Pioneers ethical sourcing initiatives, becoming one of the first jewelry houses to use 100% recycled gold.
Named one of the world's most innovative jewelry brands, with boutiques in London, Paris, and Tokyo.
For over a decade, our commitment has remained unwavering: to create jewelry that not only dazzles today but becomes tomorrow's heirlooms. Every piece we create carries this legacy forward.

contact.text: We'd love to hear from you. Reach out with any questions or inquiries.
Monday - Friday: 9:00 AM - 6:00 PMSaturday: 10:00 AM - 4:00 PMSunday: Closed
How do I determine my ring size?

We recommend visiting a local jeweler for the most accurate measurement. Alternatively, you can use our printable ring sizer available on our website or purchase a ring sizer kit from us. For reference, the average women's ring size is 6-7, and men's is 9-10.

We offer a 30-day return policy for all unworn jewelry in its original condition with all certificates and packaging. Custom pieces and engraved items cannot be returned. Returns are processed within 5-7 business days, and you will receive a full refund to your original payment method.
Do you offer custom design services?

Yes, we specialize in custom jewelry design. Our process begins with a consultation (in-person or virtual) to discuss your vision, followed by hand-drawn sketches and 3D renderings. Once approved, our master jewelers craft your piece using traditional techniques. The custom design process typically takes 4-8 weeks.
How do I care for my jewelry?

Store jewelry separately in soft pouches to prevent scratches. Avoid contact with chemicals, perfumes, and lotions. Clean gently with a soft cloth. For diamonds, use mild soap and warm water with a soft brush. Pearls should only be wiped with a damp cloth. All jewelry comes with detailed care instructions.
What shipping options do you offer?

We offer free insured shipping worldwide on all orders. Domestic orders typically arrive in 3-5 business days, while international shipping takes 7-14 business days. Express shipping (1-2 business days) is available for an additional fee. All packages require signature confirmation and are fully insured.
